actions.note: Never re-POST user task; never re-exec tools
CAS expected_revision; original terminal immutable; resumed_from link

invariants: Terminal get still returns message_snapshot for local fill — never skip fill because state is final
reconnect is events_only and does not create a new attempt
continue requires CAS expected_revision; mismatch is revision.conflict
Event recovery never executes tools; write continue is ledgered via recovery_action
Idempotent continue with same idempotency_key reuses child turn
UI reconnect and continue are separate buttons mapped from recovery_options
